title: Life Sim
tagline: Look after a little household: needs, friends, dreams, skills, pets, a job, a baby, the seasons, a house to furnish and a street of neighbours.
readinessNote: Plays end to end and saves in the browser. Things to buy, what they offer, conversations, jobs, houses and every word are data tables; the places themselves (flat, office, park, house layouts) are built in code in src/world.mjs, and src/game/page.mjs is one large file. A taker-over would first split page.mjs or add a place format.
buildYourOwn: Furniture and things to buy, what each thing lets a Sim do, conversations and romance steps, careers, houses on the street, work-station questions, and new languages.
controls: Mouse (click the floor to walk, click a thing for what to do with it, drag to look around)
